launcher.MISCONFIGURED.title: The launcher is misconfigured
launcher.REFUSED.eula_not_accepted.descr: Open the Riot Client and accept the Terms of Service, then press Play again. The Riot Client won't start League until you have.
launcher.REFUSED.eula_not_accepted.title: Riot's Terms of Service need accepting
launcher.REFUSED.title: The Riot Client refused to launch League
launcher.RIOT_CLIENT_NOT_FOUND.descripti: Check that your League installation path is set correctly in Settings - the manager reads it to work out which Riot Client owns your install.
launcher.RIOT_CLIENT_NOT_FOUND.title: Can't find your Riot Client
launcher.RIOT_CLIENT_UNREACHABLE.descrip: It's running but didn't accept the launch request. Bring it up manually and try again.
launcher.RIOT_CLIENT_UNREACHABLE.title: Couldn't reach the Riot Client
launcher.SPAWN_FAILED.description: Windows would not start it. An antivirus holding the executable, or a Riot Client that has been moved or removed, are the usual reasons - open it yourself to check.
launcher.SPAWN_FAILED.title: Couldn't start the Riot Client
launcher.UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM.descriptio: The manager can only launch League on Windows. Start it from the Riot Client.
launcher.UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM.title: Launching isn't supported here
launcher_install_mismatch_description: League is running from the *{running}* install, and LTK Manager is set up for *{configured}*. The overlay was built from the install the manager is set up for.
launcher_install_mismatch_hint: Mods built from one install crash the other. Switching saves the running install as the League path, rebuilds the overlay from it and starts the patcher again.
launcher_install_mismatch_title: A different League install is running
launcher_session_cancel_hint: Stop waiting for the Riot Client. A request it already took still starts a game.
launcher_session_content_release_hint: Content release the Riot Client reports for this session. It changes when the game patches, which is what usually breaks a mod.
launcher_session_profile_hint: This test includes profile mods. The selected profile applies when the overlay rebuilds.
launcher_session_waiting_for_the_injecto: Waiting for the injector to shut down...
launcher_session_your_mods_will_be_appli: Your mods will be applied when League starts.
